title: Build undoped Co–gN₄ slab model
action: Construct the periodic slab model of Co–gN₄ (a graphene sheet with 94 C atoms, one Co atom coordinated to four N atoms) using lattice parameters α=14.760 Å, β=17.0434 Å, c=20.0 Å.
description: Creates the baseline undoped catalyst structure for subsequent calculations.

title: Generate doped models and select most stable configurations
action: For each dopant B, N, Si, P, S: substitute carbon atoms at symmetry-distinct sites, run DFT single‑point calculations to compute formation energies ΔE_formation, and identify the lowest‑energy configuration as BNC‑1, NNC‑1, SiNC‑1, PNC‑1, SNC‑1. For B‑doping, also prepare models with 2 and 3 B atoms at equivalent BNC‑1 sites.
description: Screens all possible doping sites and identifies the thermodynamically most stable doped structure for each element. The B‑doped multi‑B models are needed for the concentration trend.

title: Compute ORR state energies and overpotentials
action: For each model (undoped Co–gN₄, BNC‑1 with 1,2,3 B atoms, NNC‑1, SiNC‑1, PNC‑1, SNC‑1), optimize the clean surface and the systems with adsorbed O₂, OOH, O, OH. Use DFT with GGA‑PBE, TS dispersion correction, and appropriate pseudopotentials. Include ZPE and entropy corrections for T=298.15 K. Construct the ORR energy profile following the appropriate mechanism for each dopant (including site poisoning for Si, P, S when thermodynamically preferred) and compute the free energy changes for states 2–5. Calculate the overpotential as η=1.23 V − min(ΔG_step)/e. Write all results to /app/outputs/or_results.csv.
description: Computes the full set of ORR adsorption energies and overpotentials for all required configurations. The CSV is the sole scored artifact.
output_schema: CSV with columns: model (string), step2_energy (float, eV), step3_energy (float, eV), step4_energy (float, eV), step5_energy (float, eV), overpotential (float, eV). One row per model: 'undoped', 'BNC-1_1B', 'BNC-1_2B', 'BNC-1_3B', 'NNC-1', 'SiNC-1', 'PNC-1', 'SNC-1'. All energies at 0 V vs. SHE.
